name: How do luxury condo valuations differ between coastal and inland properties in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: How do luxury condo valuations differ between coastal and inland properties in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condo valuations in South Florida often differ significantly between coastal and inland properties due to premium for proximity to water. Coastal properties, particularly those with ocean or Intracoastal views in areas like Miami Beach or Fort Lauderdale Beach, typically command higher values because of direct access to beaches, water activities, and often more extensive amenities. Inland luxury condos might emphasize different features, such as golf course proximity or urban convenience, influencing their market appeal and price point differently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coastal luxury condos in South Florida often have higher valuations due to water proximity and views, unlike inland properties which might value urban convenience or other features.
